meaning:
ἐπι-κάλυμμα, -τος, τό
(ἐπικαλύπτω), [in LXX: Exo.26:14 39:34, (מְכַסֶּה), 4Ki.17:19 (מָסָךְ), Job.19:29 (aliter in Heb.)* ;]
a cover, veil: metaphorically, τ. κακίας, 1Pe.2:16.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
